user.title: E.ON Sweden – Setup
user.description:
Choose how to authenticate.

**Credentials** — Home Assistant will open a headless browser to log in (requires Playwright, not available on HA OS).

**Paste tokens** — Run the `get_tokens.py` helper script on your PC, then paste the tokens here. No browser needed on HA.

credentials.title: E.ON Sweden – Log in
credentials.description: Enter your E.ON Sweden credentials. A headless browser will be launched to complete the login.

tokens.title: E.ON Sweden – Paste tokens
tokens.description:
Run `python get_tokens.py` on your PC and paste the output here.

Your personnummer and password are also required so the integration can re-authenticate automatically if the refresh token ever expires.

facilities.title: Select facilities
facilities.description: Choose which metering facilities to include. All are selected by default.
